QuestInfo.name: The Lazy Blue Monk
QuestInfo.1: #p2440001# demanded that Alpha and Beta register themselves official monk trainees with #b#p2440000##k in #m324000000#.
QuestInfo.0: With training finished, the duo could finally enter #m324000000# and search for the Goddess Teardrop in. But first, they'd need to talk to #b#p2440001##k.
QuestInfo.2: The duo ran into #p2440000#, the laziest monk on the planet, but felt something strange. #p2440000# was the Goddess Teardrop! But boy, was he a weirdo...

0.0: Uh, excuse me. I thought I told you that you were new trainees. And new trainees can't just be walking around unregistered! Go back behind the #bMu Lung Dojo#k and fill out your paperwork!

yes.0: Haha, hilarious. Good thing you didn't have to pass any comedy tests. Now stop back-sassing me, and talk to #bWoo Gong#k already.

npc.0: Why are you staring at me like I can help you? Go out behind the #bMu Lung Dojo#k and get your registration started!
